def calculate_cut_score(graph_vertices, graph_edges):
    """
    Calculate the normalized cut score of a given graph.
    """
    # Build the graph using NetworkX
    import networkx as nx
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(graph_vertices)
    G.add_edges_from(graph_edges)
    
    # Calculate the cut score
    cut_score = nx.cut_score(G)
    return cut_score

    import networkx as nx
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(graph_vertices)
    G.add_edges_from(graph_edges)
    
    # Calculate the modularity
